newsitem.title: UK: DMG buys Chase Japanese assets ops.
newsitem.headline: DMG buys Chase Japanese assets ops.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the investment banking arm of Deutsche Bank AG, said it has agreed to buy Chase Manhattan Trust and Banking (Japan) Ltd from Chase Manhattan Bank for an unspecified amount.

CMTB, whose name will be changed to Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Trust Bank Ltd, offered a full range of asset management and custodial services. "This acquisition provides...the platform to increase further our already successful asset management business in Japan," said Hitoshi Yamamoto, who will be president and chief executive of the new unit. Yamamoto said it would also offer Deutsche Bank's global custody network to existing clients.
Under Japanese banking regulations, only fully licensed trust banking companies are allowed to offer asset mangement and custody services to Japanese institutional investors.
At the end of June, the nine foreign-owned trust banks had trust assets totalling $84 billion of which $36 billion was from Japanese pension funds.
